paragraphs.text: You said that we are being pressurised by the US and China, and the Biotech Act is definitely a way how to tackle this. But do you think that is enough? Do you think the Biotech Act provides enough solutions to tackle the problem of being squeezed from both sides or do we need something more? And what concretely do you think the European Commission should do to answer this very big problem of pressure from both sides?

paragraphs.text: Thank you very much, Mr Sokol. Yes, a very good question indeed. And I do think that many of the things that we have done together already in this field and the Biotech Act II are very important cornerstones.

But I should mention one more thing that is desperately needed and that is, I guess, also in the hands of this Commissioner – but definitely in the hands of other Commissioners and Ms von der Leyen and all the countries – it is, of course, to make the capital markets union work much better and much stronger that we have seen to date.
We know that capital is the thing that is needed when we want to grow these businesses, and it is too scarce and it is too easy to go to the US and to get the capital. So yes, please, that also.

paragraphs.text: Sehr geehrter Herr Präsident, liebe Kommissarin! Die Bioökonomie bietet die einmalige Chance für Europa, einen einzigartigen Wirtschaftszweig zu erschließen, der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Nachhaltigkeit miteinander verbindet. Fakt ist: Ohne unsere Land- und Forstwirte wird dieser Sektor keinen Erfolg haben; sie dürfen nicht nur Lieferanten von Rohstoffen sein, sondern müssen weiter an der Wertschöpfungskette beteiligt werden.
Die Innovation ist da. Schon heute gibt es eine unglaubliche Bandbreite an Produkten und Prozessen, von Baumaterialien bis hin zu biobasierten Textilien: All das gibt es heute schon in Europa.

Jetzt müssen wir in die Breite kommen. Wir brauchen Investitionen und weniger Bürokratie. Wer biobasierte Produkte entwickeln will, darf nicht an komplizierten Genehmigungen oder widersprüchlichen Vorschriften scheitern. Deshalb sollte die Bioökonomie-Strategie bestehende Hemmnisse identifizieren und den Weg vorwärts aufzeigen.

Der angekündigte Biotech Act II muss nun die Bioökonomie weiter voranbringen. Wir brauchen schnellere Genehmigungsverfahren, innovationsfreundliche Rahmenbedingungen und bessere Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten, mit Land- und Forstwirtschaft im Zentrum. Bei uns schlummert so viel Potenzial: Lassen Sie uns jetzt Europa als Standort für biobasierte Produkte entfesseln!

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin! Die Bioökonomie-Strategie bietet neue Chancen für die Europäische Union: die Chance, fossile Rohstoffe zu ersetzen; die Chance, auf diesem Gebiet die Technologieführerschaft zu übernehmen, und dadurch auch die Chance, Arbeitsplätze und Wohlstand in Europa abzusichern und auszubauen, vor allem durch mehr Unabhängigkeit.

Das alles sind unterstützenswerte Ziele, und genau deshalb darf es hier nicht bei schönen Überschriften bleiben. Für mich heißt das, dass wir die Kreislaufwirtschaft weiter vorantreiben müssen und mit klaren Vorgaben gegen die Verschwendung von Ressourcen angehen. Für mich heißt das, dass wir endlich die Gesundheit unserer Böden und Gewässer sicherstellen müssen. Für mich heißt das auch, dass wir klare Regeln brauchen, mit denen unsere hohen Lebensmittelstandards und der Schutz der Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher abgesichert werden.
Eine Bioökonomie-Strategie, die auf ein starkes Fundament fußt, werde ich gerne unterstützen.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, la bioéconomie, ce sont des innovations concrètes: plastique fabriqué à partir de déchets agricoles, carburants durables, ou encore médicaments. Nous avons pour cela d’excellents chercheurs et des entreprises innovantes. Mais, trop souvent, les innovations naissent chez nous et sont industrialisées ailleurs, parce que nos entreprises ont toujours les mêmes obstacles, en Europe: des procédures trop longues, un accès au marché insuffisant et un marché européen trop fragmenté.

Nous devons changer d’échelle. Il faut pour cela davantage d’investissement, avec le soutien de la BEI et du prochain budget européen. Il faut aussi des règles qui créent de vrais débouchés pour nos produits biosourcés et qui accélèrent la construction de nouvelles usines.

La bioéconomie, c’est donc aussi une politique industrielle, une politique d’innovation et un levier essentiel pour renforcer notre autonomie stratégique. Transformons ce potentiel en emplois, en investissements et en production, ici, en Europe!

paragraphs.text: Mr President, dear Commissioners, dear colleagues, the next breakthrough that could save lives, or make plants climate resilient, or make us produce chemicals or plastics on large scales without fossil fuels, all these breakthroughs – they could come from Europe. The question is, will it? Will it be developed and produced in Europe?

Europe has it all. Europe has the knowledge, has the talent, has the innovation. We have everything to become a global leader in biotechnology. But we must ensure that those innovations will reach patients, will reach consumers, and also, for companies, it must pay off to transform. Investing in clean innovation is not an investment just in our economy. It is, above all, an investment in healthcare, an investment in sustainability, in our environment. Bioeconomy is Europe's future. By bringing together health, sustainability, competitiveness, we can really strengthen Europe's strategic autonomy.

paragraphs.text: Arvoisa puhemies, arvoisa komission jäsen, riippumattomuus Venäjän tai Lähi-idän fossiilipolttoaineista ei synny siten, että rajoitamme voimakkaasti Euroopassa uusiutuvien luonnonvarojen käyttöä. Biotalous on yksi tärkeimmistä keinoistamme vahvistaa omavaraisuutta ja rakentaa vahvempaa, uusiutuviin luonnonvaroihin perustuvaa Eurooppaa. Samalla vähennämme tuontiriippuvuutta, luomme työpaikkoja ja nostamme tietysti jalostusarvoa sekä vahvistamme huoltovarmuuttamme.

Tarvitsemme johdonmukaista sääntelyä, ilmasto- ja energiatavoitteiden yhteensovittamista, teknologianeutraalisuutta ja investointien, myös tutkimuksen, määrätietoista tukemista. Esimerkiksi ennallistamisasetuksen toimeenpanoon liittyy edelleen merkittäviä epävarmuuksia, mitä tulee sen laajuuteen, hintaan ja vaikutuksiin. Jos emme luo yrityksille ennustettavaa toimintaympäristöä, investoinnit jäävät tekemättä ja riippumattomuus jää pelkäksi puheeksi. On hyvä, että EU:n biotalousstrategia tunnistaa myös biokiertotalouden valtavan potentiaalin. Nyt tarvitaan myös poliittista rohkeutta hyödyntää sitä.

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident, liebe Frau Kommissarin, liebe Kolleginnen und Kollegen! Strategische Autonomie bedeutet nicht nur, Abhängigkeiten bei Chips, Energie oder kritischen Rohstoffen zu verringern; sie bedeutet auch, unsere eigenen biologischen Ressourcen besser zu nutzen. Die Bioökonomie kann Europa in zentralen Bereichen unabhängiger machen – bei der Lebensmittelversorgung, bei Energie, bei Gesundheit und überall dort, wo wir heute noch von fossilen Rohstoffen abhängig sind.

Das ist kein Nischenthema. Die europäische Bioökonomie steht bereits heute für mehr als 17 Millionen Arbeitsplätze und eine Wertschöpfung von 2,7 Billionen Euro. Arbeitsplätze in der Bioökonomieindustrie sind hochproduktiv und schaffen fast drei weitere indirekte Arbeitsplätze in Europa. Gerade für ländliche Räume und Küstenregionen ergeben sich hier neue Chancen.

Europa ist in der Bioökonomie nicht abgehängt – im Gegenteil, wir sind stark in Forschung und Innovation. Was uns noch fehlt, ist die industrielle Skalierung; dafür braucht es mehr Pioniergeist, mehr Investitionsbereitschaft, europaweite Harmonisierung und Leitmärkte für biobasierte Produkte.

Gut, dass die EU‑Kommission das Thema auf die Agenda gesetzt hat. Unsere Aufgabe ist es jetzt, dafür zu sorgen, dass Biotech-Cluster, Regulierung und Finanzierung besser ineinandergreifen, damit die Bioökonomie in Europa international wettbewerbsfähig wird und bleibt.

paragraphs.text: Herr talman! Biofiber i kläder och tyg, starka limträbalkar, snygga byggmaterial, gröna kemikalier, rengöringsmedel, smörjmedel, biobaserad färg och lim, bioplast, hållbara förpackningar, biogas, biodrivmedel, el och värme. Ja, listan kan göras lång.

Jag står ofta i den här talarstolen och säger att vi i EU måste bryta vårt beroende av fossila energikällor, insatsråvaror och kemikalier. Jag får lika ofta frågan, inte minst från den här sidan i parlamentet – de som förnekar klimatförändringarna och vill fortsätta handla med diktaturer och skurkstater – om hur det här ska gå till. Här har ni svaret: i bioekonomin. Låt oss göra det fossila till historia med bioresurser från skog, lantbruk och hav. Kan vi göra slut med det fossila?

Då duger det inte med EU-regler som ställer sig i vägen. Nu måste EU leverera enklare regler som möjliggör och inte blockerar skogsbruk, som bättre finansierar och tar vara på möjligheter och potentialen i hela vår biobaserade sektor.

paragraphs.text: Poštovani predsjedavajući, ako želimo istinsku stratešku autonomiju Europske unije, moramo početi od onoga što je temelj svake ekonomije, naših prirodnih resursa i sposobnosti da ih održivo koristimo.

Upravo zato bioekonomija nije samo razvojna prilika, nego strateška nužnost. Ona Europi omogućuje manju ovisnost o uvozu, jača našu proizvodnju i istodobno daje odgovor na klimatske izazove. U tome poljoprivreda ima nezamjenjivu ulogu, no ova tranzicija mora biti pravedna. Hrvatska to najbolje pokazuje: naša Slavonija, Zagorje, Međimurje, Banija, Lika, Dalmatinska zagora, Gorski kotar i brojne druge ruralne regije imaju golemi potencijal da postanu europski centri proizvodnje biomaterijala, obnovljive energije, inovacija i kvalitetnih radnih mjesta. Ono što nam nedostaje nije potencijal, nego ulaganja, moderna infrastruktura i snažnija europska potpora.
Zato trebamo ambicioznu europsku strategiju koja će povezati bioekonomiju, poljoprivredu i regionalni razvoj te ulagati upravo ondje gdje Europa može biti najjača: u svojim regijama.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, there is something in the leftist logic that I simply cannot understand. You claim to want a cleaner and more autonomous Europe, yet your actions contradict your words.

In the energy sector, you push electrification while undermining Europe's nuclear industry. You want batteries instead of petrol, but you oppose mines for the critical raw materials that batteries require.
The same contradiction applies to the automotive sector. You push electric vehicles while burdening European producers – it is almost like calling on China to dominate our automotive market.

When forestry companies are innovating to build a bio-based future, you oppose them and demand limitations on harvesting the material that is needed for wood-based products. The leftist logic is hurting Europe.

In the energy sector, you push electrification while undermining Europe's nuclear industry. You want batteries instead of petrol, but you oppose mines for the critical raw materials that batteries require.

The same contradiction applies to the automotive sector. You push electric vehicles while burdening European producers – it is almost like calling on China to dominate our automotive market.

When forestry companies are innovating to build a bio-based future, you oppose them and demand limitations on harvesting the material that is needed for wood-based products. The leftist logic is hurting Europe.

paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, doamnă comisar, stimați colegi, sigur că Uniunea Europeană are nevoie de o strategie în domeniul bioeconomiei. Numai că, doamnă comisar, chiar dumneavoastră ați spus, că există capital, dar oare ce ne lipsește? Încrederea.

Pentru că de foarte multe ori, în această perioadă, în Uniunea Europeană s-au făcut reglementări care se obstrucționează unele pe altele. Și ca să vă dau un exemplu concret: se vorbea aici de biotehnologia farmaceutică și este foarte important să avem această independență într-o industrie de care depinde, de fapt, viața oamenilor. Dar avem o directivă - directiva privind apele uzate. Noi, Parlamentul, am votat o rezoluție să o schimbați pentru că este prost gândită și are un impact și închide pe rând fabricile de medicamente.

Vă mai pot da exemple în domeniul textil - unde am lucrat vreo 36 de ani - că ani de zile Uniunea Europeană a ars câmpul cu cânepă, considerând-o absolut neutilizabilă și dăunătoare. De fapt, este o plantă textilă ecologică, care poate fi folosită în toate domeniile și este cea mai eficientă - pentru că nu arunci nimic din ea, de la uleiuri până la reziduuri care se folosesc în domeniul construcțiilor.

Și atunci lipsa aceasta de încredere că există o continuitate a politicilor face ca investitorul să nu investească. Poate că veniți să eliminați acele bariere, pentru că mai avem o barieră, bariera tarifelor, pentru că puneți taxe vamale - și o spun mereu aici - la materii prime mai mici decât la produsele finite.

Pentru că de foarte multe ori, în această perioadă, în Uniunea Europeană s-au făcut reglementări care se obstrucționează unele pe altele. Și ca să vă dau un exemplu concret: se vorbea aici de biotehnologia farmaceutică și este foarte important să avem această independență într-o industrie de care depinde, de fapt, viața oamenilor. Dar avem o directivă - directiva privind apele uzate. Noi, Parlamentul, am votat o rezoluție să o schimbați pentru că este prost gândită și are un impact și închide pe rând fabricile de medicamente.

Vă mai pot da exemple în domeniul textil - unde am lucrat vreo 36 de ani - că ani de zile Uniunea Europeană a ars câmpul cu cânepă, considerând-o absolut neutilizabilă și dăunătoare. De fapt, este o plantă textilă ecologică, care poate fi folosită în toate domeniile și este cea mai eficientă - pentru că nu arunci nimic din ea, de la uleiuri până la reziduuri care se folosesc în domeniul construcțiilor.

Și atunci lipsa aceasta de încredere că există o continuitate a politicilor face ca investitorul să nu investească. Poate că veniți să eliminați acele bariere, pentru că mai avem o barieră, bariera tarifelor, pentru că puneți taxe vamale - și o spun mereu aici - la materii prime mai mici decât la produsele finite.

interventions.speaker_label: Jessika Roswall, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, honourable Members, thank you very much for this debate. It was really encouraging for me. I would just briefly repeat some things.

Bioeconomy is a big sector – I talked about it in the beginning, many have repeated it – and it has big potential. We also see the great importance for our resilience with bioeconomy. Biofertilisers were mentioned – I totally agree that we can create our own home-grown fertilisers. Competitiveness will be encouraged by this, but also of course fighting climate change, decarbonisation and the dependencies that we have today.

Of course, I also see the challenges. Access to the market was mentioned by many. That is actually the one thing that is mentioned over and over again when I visit innovative companies all around Europe . The need for scale up, the need for finance, but also, as I said at the beginning, it's not always the lack of capital, but it's the mismatch of capital.

I will end my intervention stealing what MEP Sean Kelly said. He said, 'Let us now use this momentum.' That was my words maybe, but 'let's put the circular bioeconomy at the heart of our industrial agenda.'
Thank you very much for the debate.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, colleagues, starvation, rape, enforced disappearances and torture as weapons of war. Thousands have been killed and many more have been forced to flee their homes. This is what the world was witnessing in El Fasher just months ago.

Today, the people of El‑Obeid face the same horrific fate. For months, the RSF siege entrapped half a million men, women and children. Drone strikes on fuel stations and hospitals have deprived people from food, healthcare and safety, leaving them to live in constant fear.

Europe has not done enough to prevent what could become another massacre in El-Obeid, despite our moral and legal responsibility to act. Today, we call on the Council and the Commission to change this course, impose sanctions on those responsible for this crime, and use every available lever to end the external support that is fuelling Sudan's suffering.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, colleagues, the clock is ticking for the people in El-Obeid, and today we have the eighth debate this mandate on Sudan. The EU has the opportunity to curb further human suffering, so I look to you, Commissioner: Article 21 of the Treaty on European Union places upon you – on the Commission – the responsibility for consistent foreign policy.

Consistent foreign policy is not giving a little aid to victims of the humanitarian disaster, and bags of support for those who sustain it. It is not condemning violations of human rights and clearing the room for the lobbyists of the very financiers of those war crimes. It is not millions of euros for humanitarian support to the Sudanese people, and billions of euros for trade to the United Arab Emirates. But it is providing support for those who need it most, imposing sanctions on those who sustain this conflict, considering the inclusion of the RSF on the EU's terrorist list, and demanding that all perpetrators of war crimes across Sudan be held accountable.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, dear colleagues, 33 million: that is the number of people in Sudan who urgently need humanitarian assistance, and 16 million of them are children.

Colleagues, the situation in Sudan is worsening by the day. The RSF are now threatening an offensive on El-Obeid, putting 500 000 civilians at risk. We have already witnessed the horror of El Fasher. We cannot allow another massacre to happen. We must increase humanitarian assistance, ensure humanitarian access and support those working on the ground to save lives. But we must also hold those who are responsible to account. The Council must adopt targeted restrictive measures against commanders, financiers and external enablers – such as the UAE‑based private security company Global Security Services Group – for providing military support to the RSF.
Colleagues, our commitment to international law is tested not by our words but by our actions. The people of Sudan are suffering and we must not look away.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, first of all, thank you all colleagues, for the collaboration on this resolution. I put it on the agenda because we urgently need decisive action to save lives in Sudan – 33 million dependent on aid, 19 million facing hunger, and now the siege on El‑Obeid that will escalate this crisis, especially for women and children.

It's remarkable how easily some in this House pretend to care about women's rights. But behind closed doors they just care about the UAE, and I'm looking to the far‑right colleagues over there. The UAE is the state that is funding the war, and the rape and trafficking of women. Last time, too many Members on that side of the house stayed silent when we all wanted to hold the Emirates accountable. And here we are again.

Now there's even more evidence of the Emirates funding the war in Sudan. They are responsible for this genocide, and it is time they paid for it. I think tomorrow is the time to vote in favour of this resolution for women's rights.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señorías, supongo que han visto ustedes imágenes de mujeres en Sudán con sus hijos encima llorando de desesperación.

Ante esto hay dos opciones. Una es explicar lo que sucede en Sudán recurriendo al viejo relato del colonialismo según el cual los conflictos en el Sur Global se deben a que son unos bárbaros, a que no saben convivir en paz, a que no saben autogobernarse. Bajo ese relato siempre se han justificado las invasiones extranjeras y se ha callado ante la violencia que suponen.

Y hay otra opción: decir la verdad. Decir la verdad en el caso de Sudán implica decir que los 60 000 muertos son consecuencia de la responsabilidad de Occidente y sus aliados; que los Emiratos Árabes Unidos introducen las armas que sirven para cometer un genocidio y que extraen el oro de Sudán; que —como todos y todas sabemos— el Gobierno de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos es un Gobierno títere de los Estados Unidos e Israel; que los planes expansionistas del sionismo están detrás del genocidio que se está cometiendo en Sudán; y, otra vez más, que los Estados Unidos e Israel son la principal amenaza para la humanidad.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, la situazione nella città di El Obeid, 340 000 abitanti, sta precipitando.

Centinaia di migliaia di civili sono intrappolati nei combattimenti, mentre continuano gli attacchi contro la popolazione e l'infrastruttura civile. L'Alto Commissario delle Nazioni Unite per i diritti umani ha confermato che i civili vivono in questa città da 18 mesi sotto assedio permanente e che si rischia una nuova tragedia umanitaria.

Sia chiaro: in Sudan non esiste una soluzione militare. Entrambe le parti sono responsabili di gravissime violazioni del diritto internazionale umanitario. Per questo, chiediamo un cessate il fuoco immediato, il pieno rispetto della dichiarazione di Gedda, un accesso umanitario senza ostacoli e sanzioni più severe contro chi alimenta il conflitto e impedisce addirittura l'arrivo di aiuti umanitari.

Non ci sarà pace finché il futuro del Sudan resterà nelle mani di questi gruppi estremisti. I Fratelli mussulmani hanno alimentato per anni radicalizzazione, violenza e instabilità in Sudan e in tutta la regione.
L'Unione europea, insieme alle Nazioni Unite e all'Unione africana, deve sostenere un processo politico che escluda ogni influenza dei movimenti islamisti radicali.

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin! Der Sudan gleicht der Hölle auf Erden – über 150 000 Tote, 14 Millionen Vertriebene, 25 Millionen Hungernde, massenhaft Vergewaltigungen und systematische Verfolgungen von Christen und nicht-arabischen Minderheiten. Es drohen jetzt weitere Massaker – wir verurteilen das aufs Schärfste.

Natürlich befeuert dieser Konflikt auch Massenmigration nach Europa. Wer aber den halben Sudan aufnimmt, hilft nicht dem Sudan, sondern wird selbst zum Sudan. Wir müssen daher unsere Außengrenzen schützen, und wir sollten dort helfen, wo es sinnvoll ist, nämlich in der Region, gemeinsam mit den Nachbarstaaten; das ist Diplomatie.

Es geht darum, Realismus mit Humanität zu verbinden: klare Kante gegen Kriegsverbrechen, keine Waffenlieferungen, die den Konflikt nur verlängern, regionale Stabilität statt weiterer Anreize für Massenmigration und deshalb enge Kooperation mit den Staaten der Region statt Werteimperialismus. Denn eine tragfähige Friedenslösung ist nur dann möglich, wenn man die regionalen und kulturellen Kontexte berücksichtigt; wer diese ignoriert, verschlimmert nur das Chaos.
Das ist eine Politik der Verantwortung gegenüber den Menschen im Sudan und gegenüber den Menschen in Europa.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Powiem tak: Sudan to nasza sprawa. Sudan to nasza sprawa, bo kiedy głód staje się bronią, pojawia się co? Migracja.

Usłyszałam dzisiaj dwie złe odpowiedzi na ten temat. Pierwsza to lewicowe marzenia, że wystarczy otworzyć drzwi i świat się sam ułoży. Otóż nie ułoży się. Mieliśmy już tego przykłady. Druga odpowiedź: migracja to ryzyko – kto temu zaprzecza, nie kocha Europy.

Ta druga odpowiedź to prawicowy kabotynizm. Wiecie co? Mamy na tej sali europosła, który biega po ulicy i nagrywa ludzi tylko dlatego, że mają inny kolor skóry. To po prostu świr. Musimy wybrać inną drogę. Korytarze humanitarne – natychmiast. Rozliczenie zbrodni wojennych – natychmiast. Musimy działać, nie czekać.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhora Comissária, depois de Zamzam e El-Fasher, El-Obeid corre o risco de ser o epicentro de uma nova tragédia no Sudão.

El-Obeid, que alberga uma população de meio milhão de habitantes, mas também um número indeterminado de pessoas internamente deslocadas, e que está desde há meses cercada. El-Obeid onde, aos ataques contínuos de drones que destruíram infraestruturas essenciais, semeando a fome e a cólera, ameaça agora juntar-se a repetição do massacre de civis a que assistimos antes, quando as Forças Rápidas de Suporte e as Forças Armadas Sudanesas se confrontaram, alimentadas pelo exterior.

«Os países com influência têm o dever de a exercer agora para parar esta loucura», foram as palavras do Alto Representante das Nações Unidas para os Direitos Humanos. E é isso que, hoje, pedimos que a União Europeia, mas também os Estados Unidos, o Egito, os Emirados Árabes Unidos façam. Respeito pelo bloqueio na entrada de armas, sanções individuais e responsabilização, participação na construção de uma solução civil para o conflito.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, mes chers collègues, à El-Obeid, les populations subissent des bombardements, des exécutions, des viols, des déplacements forcés et des violations répétées du droit international humanitaire. Il semble que nous soyons tous d’accord aujourd’hui pour faire ce constat.

On notera cependant qu’étrangement, on entend peu les élus d’extrême gauche – et je veux parler particulièrement de La France insoumise – autour de ce sujet. Il faut dire qu’ici il n’y a d’opportunité ni d’attaquer les Juifs ni d’attaquer Israël.

Alors la réalité – certains l’ont dit –, c’est que nombre d’États sont complices de ce qui se passe au Soudan, puisque les Émirats arabes unis, qui soutiennent les forces de soutien rapides à l’origine des massacres, jouissent chez nous, c’est vrai, d’un passe-droit scandaleux acheté à coups de pétrodollars.

Oui, si nous voulons arrêter de regarder ailleurs ou sortir de l’incantation pour réellement stopper ces massacres et ces exactions, commençons par pointer les vrais responsables et prenons aussi les mesures qui sont à notre portée!

interventions.speaker_label: Dubravka Šuica, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Vice-President, honourable Members, as we speak, the Sudanese city of El-Obeid, the capital of North Kordofan stands on the brink of catastrophe. About the size of Poznań, Lyon, or Lisbon, and home to one of Sudan's largest universities, it shelters some 500 000 people, including more than 100 000 who have already been displaced at least once this year.

Today, all of them are in danger. For the past three weeks, drone strikes have hit the city. Dozens of civilians have been killed. Fuel depots, power and water supply lines and medical facilities have been struck. And around El-Obeid, the rapid support forces are amassing their forces for what could be an imminent, large‑scale assault.

We have seen this before in El Fasher in October 2025: the mass killings, the ethnically targeted violence, the sexual violence. The UN's independent international fact‑finding mission documented it. El-Obeid must not become another El Fasher.

So let me be clear on what the European Union demands. The European Union calls on the Rapid Support Forces to halt their assault immediately, and to refrain from any offensive that would place civilians at risk of mass atrocities. Credible reports of ethnically targeted violence are already emerging. International humanitarian law must be respected. Civilians must be free to leave safely. Humanitarian actors must be granted rapid, safe and unhindered access to everyone in need, underpinned by credible security guarantees.

The EU calls on those who support and have influence over the Rapid Support Forces to use that influence now. The responsibility does not rest with the warring parties alone; it rests also with those who arm them, finance them and enable them.

And the European Union is not a bystander. The European Council conclusions on Sudan, adopted in October 2025, spell out four key asks to all parties of the conflict: ceasefire, humanitarian access and protection of civilians, civilian governance and accountability. Our Special Representative for the Horn of Africa has reached out to the Rapid Support Forces at every level of their leadership, and through our regional partners. The European Union is engaged with the Quintet and with the wider international community to press for a cessation of hostilities and return to credible, civilian‑led transition.

The European Union has already imposed restrictive measures on those fuelling this conflict, linked to both the Rapid Support Forces and the Sudanese Armed Forces, and we stand ready to act again. Those who commit atrocities and those who command them will be held to account through our sanctions, through the independent fact‑finding mission to Sudan and through the International Criminal Court. Impunity is not an option.

Dear Members, we are raising the alarm now so that the international community is not left, once again, to document the massacre after it has happened. As Sudan's war has entered its fourth year, we call on the parties for constructive engagement in negotiations towards an immediate ceasefire. Only so can the suffering of the Sudanese people end.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, dear colleagues, as Commissioner Šuica mentioned, the humanitarian catastrophe unfolding in El‑Obeid is yet another tragic reminder that the people of Sudan continue to pay the highest price for a conflict they did not choose.

Reports of discriminate attacks on civilians, the destruction of vital infrastructure and the obstruction of humanitarian assistance raise serious concerns about violations of international humanitarian law. Those responsible for atrocities against civilians must be held accountable.
At the same time, we must ensure that humanitarian organisations can reach those in need. Millions of Sudanese are facing displacement, hunger and a complete lack of basic services.

We have to call to all parties and also external actors to agree to an immediate ceasefire, engaging, meaningful dialogue and working towards a peaceful, Sudanese‑led political process that respects human dignity and the rule of law.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señora comisaria, les confieso que asisto a este debate con dosis de frustración y de impotencia, porque traemos una y otra vez el debate sobre Sudán a esta Cámara mientras Sudán se desangra y El Obeid se convierte en un símbolo de una tragedia anunciada una y otra vez.

En apenas tres semanas ha habido quince ataques con drones en la ciudad, ejecuciones sumarias, secuestros, tortura y violencia sexual en la región. Hay más de 13 millones de personas desplazadas, más de 33 millones necesitan ayuda urgente y millones viven bajo la amenaza del hambre. Pero al mundo directamente no le importa.

Debemos exigir de una vez por todas el cese inmediato de los ataques a los civiles, a las escuelas, a los mercados. El Derecho humanitario internacional no puede ser una promesa vacía ni una norma selectiva, debe ser siempre nuestra brújula de forma coherente.

Es verdad que la Unión Europea ha estado a la altura en la necesidad de la ayuda humanitaria, pero no es suficiente. Tenemos que desplegar la diplomacia humanitaria, garantizar los corredores y, sobre todo, parar esta barbarie de una vez por todas. La respuesta humanitaria necesita 2 900 millones de dólares, el 0,1 % del gasto militar, para abordar 20 millones de personas y sus necesidades. A nadie le importa y no estamos a la altura.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, Madame la Commissaire, chers collègues, c’est la troisième fois en six mois qu’une discussion alarmante de la situation dramatique au Soudan est à l’ordre du jour de cette assemblée. À chaque fois, nous dénonçons les massacres, les conditions de vie, voire de survie, des populations déplacées, de millions d’enfants menacés par la famine, de femmes et de jeunes filles exposées aux violences sexuelles, sans oublier les dizaines de milliers de morts.
La dernière fois, il s’agissait également d’attirer l’attention sur l’ingérence extérieure, et notamment celle des Émirats arabes unis.

Aujourd’hui, c’est la situation d’El-Obeid qui nous préoccupe. Il est impératif que l’Union européenne mette en place des mesures de protection immédiates. Les populations d’El-Obeid doivent être protégées. L’Union européenne doit être à leurs côtés.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Islam is not a religion of peace. I know that might be hard for some people to hear, but the evidence is overwhelming. Some will angrily say that not all Muslims are violent. I would agree. However, Islam is the vehicle that has caused terror and suffering across the globe. Let me give you an example. Besides the devastating civil war, Sudan, for example, has suffered from jihadist terrorism and Islamist oppression. The country is ranked in the top five for Christian persecution.

When Islam becomes the majority, minorities pay the price. They are silenced, many of them even abducted, raped, murdered or have their lands taken away from them. We cannot talk about solutions without recognising the problem. The problem is Islam not respecting the dignity of human life.

paragraphs.text: Cristian Terheş (ECR), in writingThe resolution on the El-Obeid humanitarian catastrophe has been used by the left-wing and progressive groups in the European Parliament to attack the United Arab Emirates, instead of focusing strictly on resolving the humanitarian crisis in Sudan. This approach is even more problematic as the resolution ignores the role of actual malign actors, like Russia, Iran, and others, whose actions have contributed to this conflict. EP should have remained focused on the humanitarian disaster in El-Obeid by prioritizing the protection of civilians, ensuring humanitarian access, and supporting accountability for all perpetrators on the basis of verified evidence. Instead, the resolution devotes particular attention to the UAE while failing to acknowledge the broad network of external actors that has fueled and prolonged this conflict. Numerous reports have documented the involvement of Russian-linked Wagner forces and their successor structures, alongside other foreign actors, in sustaining violence and instability in Sudan. Instead of being constructive, the resolution was weaponized by the left-wing and progressive groups to attack the UAE so they could score political points in their home countries. Humanitarian resolutions should remain impartial, evidence-based, and centered on the victims. Selectively and incorrectly attributing responsibility undermines the credibility of Parliament's message and its position as an effective actor in this conflict resolution.

political_group.label: PPE
political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, dear colleagues, the horrific attacks in Kawel village – where innocent Christians, including their pastor, were brutally killed – are yet another tragic reminder of the escalating violence against Christian communities in Nigeria. Sadly, this is not an isolated incident. Nigeria has become one of the most dangerous places in the world to be a Christian. Across the country, Christian communities face repeated attacks by Fulani militants, Boko Haram and other organised groups. Violence is part of a broader and deeply worrying pattern of persecution.

The EU must therefore strongly condemn these attacks and press the Nigerian Government to step up its fight against the armed militant groups responsible for this violence. I call on the Commission to give urgent attention to the worrying situation of Christians in Nigeria and all persecuted religious communities in Nigeria.

We had a very fruitful discussion this morning with the newly appointed EU Special Envoy on religious freedom, Mairead McGuinness, and I look forward to working with her to help Christian and other religious groups facing persecution.

We had a very fruitful discussion this morning with the newly appointed EU Special Envoy on religious freedom, Mairead McGuinness, and I look forward to working with her to help Christian and other religious groups facing persecution.

paragraphs.text: Weer ging het afschuwelijk mis in Nigeria. Nu in het dorp Kawel, waar tientallen christenen het leven lieten bij een aanval door extremisten. Maar ik denk ook aan de tientallen scholieren die recent werden ontvoerd in de deelstaat Borno. De aanslagen en de ontvoeringen gaan maar door en nemen in intensiteit alleen maar toe.
Onze resolutie spreekt duidelijke taal. Wij roepen Nigeria op het probleem onder ogen te zien, de bevolking veel beter te beschermen en de daders te straffen.

Maar de vraag is ook vandaag: wat kunnen wij doen om het geweld in Nigeria te helpen stoppen? Welke mogelijkheden ziet u, commissaris? Ziet u bijvoorbeeld mogelijkheden om Nigeria te helpen bij het trainen van politiemensen? Natuurlijk is Nigeria primair zelf verantwoordelijk, maar als we kijken naar de escalatie van het geweld in de regio, mogen wij niet werkeloos toezien.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, innocent people were massacred at the Kawel village and our thoughts are with the families of the victims.

The violence in Nigeria is driven by disputes over land and water, climate change, poverty, criminality, weak governance, persistent impunity and deep‑rooted religious, ethnic and intercommunal tensions. Together, these pressures have fuelled a brutal cycle of revenge and breaking that cycle requires more than expressions of outrage.

To the colleagues who rightly demand the protection of Christian communities in Nigeria, I ask to look at the actions of your global conservative allies. Last year, Trump dismantled USAID with enormous consequences in Nigeria. Hundreds of schools in conflict‑affected areas were closed. One fifth of the national healthcare budget was taken away. Imagine the consequences on maternal health and on the fight against HIV.
Conservatives have defunded the very local networks, many of them Christian faith‑based healthcare providers, that offered a frontline against poverty and radicalisation.

I call on the EU to be a committed partner in supporting humanitarian aid, conflict prevention, justice reform and climate resilience, on the Nigerian authorities to protect all civilians, and on my colleagues to also make sure that right‑wing populism doesn't cut away international aid.

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin! Am 22. Juni verüben bewaffnete Milizionäre im Dorf Kawel im nigerianischen Bundesstaat Plateau ein Massaker. Mindestens 22 unschuldige Menschen wurden in dieser christlichen Gemeinde, die nicht geschützt wurde, getötet.

Angriffe auf christliche Dorfgemeinschaften, auf Bäuerinnen und Bauern, auf Geistliche, Schulen und Gesundheitseinrichtungen nehmen zu, ebenso die Entführungen; Frauen und Mädchen sind massiv betroffen. Die katholische Bischofskonferenz Nigerias bekräftigt, dass Christen genauso wie Muslime Opfer des anhaltenden Terrorismus sind.

Gezielte Gewalt gegen Zivilisten wurzelt in Konflikten um politische Macht, Landstreitigkeiten, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Sektenzugehörigkeit und Bandenkriminalität. Wir erwarten von den nigerianischen Behörden entschlossenes Handeln: eine umfassende Untersuchung des Massakers von Kawel, strafrechtliche Verfolgung der Täter und wirksamen Schutz gefährdeter Gemeinden und der Zivilbevölkerung sowie die entschiedene Bekämpfung bewaffneter Gruppen.
Wo Menschen aufgrund ihres Glaubens verfolgt werden, greift das die Religionsfreiheit an, und das ist ein fundamentales Menschenrecht, das wir schützen müssen.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, silenzio, il mondo tace mentre in Nigeria si consuma una strage: decine e decine di cristiani massacrati ancora, ogni settimana, nell'indifferenza generale.
Solo nel 2025 si parla di 3 500 cristiani uccisi da mani islamiste. Non sono numeri: sono famiglie intere sterminate, villaggi rasi al suolo, chiese bruciate con i fedeli dentro.
È una strategia precisa: terrorizzare, confiscare le loro terre, sradicare un'intera comunità. Non è più un'emergenza umanitaria, ormai le caratteristiche sono quelle di un genocidio.

I cristiani sono oggi il gruppo religioso più perseguitato al mondo, ma continuate a girarvi dall'altra parte o a parlare di un'inesistente islamofobia. L'Europa non riconosce né contrasta questa persecuzione islamista.
Non possiamo più aspettare. Ogni giorno di silenzio è complice di chi ammazza i cristiani.

paragraphs.text: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin! Weltweit werden rund 400 Millionen Christen verfolgt; Christen sind damit die am stärksten verfolgte Glaubensgemeinschaft weltweit. Besonders brutal ist diese Verfolgung in Nigeria; nirgendwo auf der Welt werden mehr Christen ermordet als dort – ermordet aus einem Grund: weil sie Christen sind. So geschehen auch vor zwei Wochen: Fulani-Milizen ermordeten mindestens 23 Christen im Dorf Kawel, darunter einen Pastor. Der US-Gesandte bei der UN, Mike Waltz, sagt, das ist keine zufällige Gewalt, das ist ein Genozid, ein Genozid an Christen.

All diese Fakten sind seit Langem bekannt, doch in Europa spricht man kaum darüber. Warum? Vielleicht, weil die Opfer Christen und die Täter Islamisten sind. Wir aber sollten die Täter beim Namen nennen: Boko Haram, der westafrikanische Ableger des „Islamischen Staates“, Fulani-Milizen – kurzum islamistische Terroristen. Sie morden, entführen, vergewaltigen, foltern.

Wir können das nicht länger hinnehmen; wir müssen Druck ausüben. Nigeria muss seine Christen schützen; Nigeria muss den islamistischen Terror bekämpfen. Dafür muss Nigeria seine Institutionen stärken – Polizei, Justiz, Sicherheitsapparat. Falls nicht, darf kein Cent mehr von uns nach Nigeria fließen.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señora comisaria, no puede ser que la matanza de cristianos por motivos religiosos no nos despierte la misma indignación que nos provocan otras matanzas y persecuciones en el mundo.

Les doy unos datos: según datos de Open Doors, 388 millones de cristianos están perseguidos en el mundo y el año pasado hubo 4 849 asesinados. Especialmente grave es el caso de Nigeria, donde se da el 72 % de estos asesinatos, la mayoría ejecutados por grupos terroristas islamistas. No podemos caer en la trampa de pensar que aquí lo que está ocurriendo son guerras entre clanes por recursos naturales. Está habiendo una persecución real de cristianos y Europa no puede permanecer callada.

Desde la Unión Europea debemos tomar medidas, debemos endurecer nuestro régimen de sanciones así como la condicionalidad y el control de nuestras ayudas a terceros países para evitar financiar aquellos Estados, como el de Nigeria, que de una manera activa o pasiva permiten esta violencia contra los cristianos y este atentado contra los derechos humanos.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, Madame la Commissaire, chers collègues, parler de la situation au Nigeria dans cet hémicycle permet de mettre en lumière les persécutions et violences quotidiennes auxquelles doivent faire face les civils. Réduire le débat à la religion est cependant la preuve que beaucoup ici n’ont pas compris ce qui se passe dans ce pays, ou alors qu’ils ne veulent pas le comprendre. Ou simplement ils se servent de ces atrocités pour servir leur agenda politique.

Comment ne pas voir que les victimes des massacres ont un seul point commun: non pas leur religion, mais le fait d’être civil? Comment ne pas voir l’influence du changement climatique, de la pression démographique, de la raréfaction des terres dans ces conflits?
Il est de notre devoir d’élus de faire preuve d’honnêteté intellectuelle afin d’apporter un réel soutien à la population nigériane, sans quoi nous continuerons à compter les morts.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhora Comissária, quando denunciou a perseguição e o suplício de Jean Calas, Voltaire não estava apenas a fazer a defesa de um homem injustamente condenado: estava a lembrar a toda a Europa que toda a intolerância praticada em nome de Deus é, sempre, um pacto com o Diabo.
A intolerância desumaniza, simultaneamente, a sua vítima e o seu autor. Dessa denúncia nasceu um tratado sobre a tolerância que permanece uma das magnas cartas da Europa.

Por isso, quando me chegam relatos de comunidades cristãs ameaçadas na Nigéria, no Sudão, em Moçambique ou um pouco por todo o Médio Oriente, ouvimos mais do que notícias distantes. Reconhecemos os nossos demónios.

A Europa tem uma responsabilidade especial de proteger as comunidades cristãs, onde quer que elas sejam perseguidas, porque em cada Jean Calas silenciado - na Europa de ontem, ou na África e no Médio Oriente de hoje - ouvimos, de novo, a voz de Voltaire.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! W czerwcu 2026 r. w wiosce Kawel w stanie Plateau w Nigerii doszło do brutalnego ataku na chrześcijańską społeczność. Dziesiątki osób zginęły, wiele zostało rannych, a cała wioska została zniszczona. To nie jest pojedynczy incydent, lecz element szerszego, powtarzającego się wzoru prześladowanych chrześcijan w regionie, ataków na rolników, kościoły, szkoły, duchownych. I mimo wielokrotnych ostrzeżeń władze nigeryjskie nie zapewniły ochrony, a sprawcy nadal cieszą się bezkarnością.

Potępiamy tę zbrodnię z całą stanowczością. Wyrażamy głębokie współczucie rodzinom ofiar. Wzywamy rząd Nigerii do natychmiastowego, transparentnego śledztwa, ukarania winnych i przerwania kultury bezkarności. Apelujemy o realne wzmocnienie ochrony ludności chrześcijańskiej i podjęcie konkretnych działań przeciwko fali przemocy.

Niestety, reakcja Unii Europejskiej pozostaje dalece niewystarczająca. Oficjalna linia Unii Europejskiej, w tym wypowiedzi wysokiej przedstawiciel Kai Kallas, unika jasnego określenia tych wydarzeń mianem prześladowania chrześcijan. Zamiast tego skupia się na złożonych czynnikach, konfliktach o ziemię między rolnikami a hodowcami, zmianami klimatu, działalności bandytów i terrorystów. Jednocześnie Unia z niezwykłą czujnością doszukuje się przejawów islamofobii w Europie, nawet tam, gdzie chodzi o uzasadnioną krytykę radykalnego islamu.

To wyraźny przejaw odchodzenia europejskich elit od chrześcijańskich korzeni Europy. Unia powstała w oparciu o chrześcijańskie wartości, godność osoby ludzkiej, sprawiedliwość, solidarność. Fundamenty Europy są chrześcijańskie. Nie możemy więc pozostawać obojętni na cierpienie milionów chrześcijan na świecie, od lat najbardziej prześladowanej grupy religijnej.

Takie selektywne podejście źle wróży przyszłości Europy. Osłabia naszą spójność kulturową. Ignoruje realia demograficzne i pozbawia nas zdolności do skutecznego przeciwstawienia się radykalnemu islamowi. Czas, by Europa wróciła do swoich korzeni, nie tylko słowami, ale także czynami.

interventions.speaker_label: Marcin Sypniewski, w imieniu grupy ESN.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Nigeria zajmuje siódme miejsce w światowym rankingu prześladowań chrześcijan Open Doors, a jednocześnie pozostaje krajem, w którym ginie ich najwięcej na świecie. Według raportu European Center for Law and Justice tylko w pierwszych 220 dniach w 2025 roku zamordowano ponad 7000 chrześcijan, a między styczniem a kwietniem tego roku kolejnych 1400. A my od lat słyszymy o konfliktach o ziemię. Ale jak konfliktem o ziemię wytłumaczyć palenie kościołów, ataki na chrześcijańskie wsie, mordowanie wiernych podczas nabożeństw czy okrzyki wzywające Allaha podczas masakr? Trzeba to powiedzieć jasno, że za tymi zbrodniami stoją ugrupowania islamistyczne. Dodatkowo w dwunastu północnych stanach Nigerii obowiązuje szariat, a wpływy radykalnych środowisk islamskich stale rosną.

Obecny prezydent, jak i wiceprezydent są muzułmanami, co łamie obowiązującą od lat zasadę, zgodnie z którą chrześcijanin i muzułmanin są zrównoważeni na najwyższych stanowiskach państwowych. A tymczasem Unia Europejska nadal pogłębia strategiczne partnerstwo z Nigerią w obszarze bezpieczeństwa, migracji, energii i rozwoju gospodarczego. Przeznaczyła ponad 700 milionów euro grantów na lata 2021–27 dla Nigerii, w której łamane są prawa człowieka.
Musimy upomnieć się o chrześcijan, gdziekolwiek oni żyją, gdziekolwiek mieszkają, dlatego, że Europa będzie chrześcijańska albo nie będzie jej wcale.

Trzeba to powiedzieć jasno, że za tymi zbrodniami stoją ugrupowania islamistyczne. Dodatkowo w dwunastu północnych stanach Nigerii obowiązuje szariat, a wpływy radykalnych środowisk islamskich stale rosną.

Obecny prezydent, jak i wiceprezydent są muzułmanami, co łamie obowiązującą od lat zasadę, zgodnie z którą chrześcijanin i muzułmanin są zrównoważeni na najwyższych stanowiskach państwowych. A tymczasem Unia Europejska nadal pogłębia strategiczne partnerstwo z Nigerią w obszarze bezpieczeństwa, migracji, energii i rozwoju gospodarczego. Przeznaczyła ponad 700 milionów euro grantów na lata 2021–27 dla Nigerii, w której łamane są prawa człowieka.

Musimy upomnieć się o chrześcijan, gdziekolwiek oni żyją, gdziekolwiek mieszkają, dlatego, że Europa będzie chrześcijańska albo nie będzie jej wcale.

paragraphs.text: Gerbiamas Pirmininke, komisare, kolegos. Žudynės, įvykdytos Nigerijoje, Kawel kaime, sukrėtė ne tik vietos bendruomenes, bet ir visą civilizuotą pasaulį. Ginkluotos islamistų grupuotės jau ne vienerius metus terorizuoja Nigerijos kaimus ir bendruomenes. Bendrai Afrika šiandien išlieka smurto prieš krikščionis epicentru, o Nigerijoje matome ne pavienius nusikaltimus, bet pasikartojančius, koordinuotus išpuolius net prieš dvasininkus ir bažnyčias. Tai sąmoningai toleruojamas smurtas ir valstybės pareigos ignoravimas, kurio nebeįmanoma paslėpti už atsargių diplomatinių formuluočių. Nigerijos valdžia privalo ginti savo piliečius, tirti nusikaltimus ir bausti vykdytojus. Europos Sąjunga privalo kalbėti griežtai: remti aukas, spausti valdžią ir taikyti priemones tiems, kurie kursto ir finansuoja ar dangsto šį terorą. Tikėjimo laisvė yra pamatinė žmogaus teisė ir ji turi būti ginama ne rytoj, o dabar ir be išlygų.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, quello che sta accadendo in Nigeria non può essere liquidato come un semplice conflitto tribale: è una persecuzione folle contro i cristiani.

E i numeri sono terribili: 3 490 cristiani uccisi in un anno per motivi legati alla fede, significa che quasi tre cristiani su quattro uccisi nel mondo sono stati uccisi in Nigeria. Villaggi distrutti, chiese attaccate, famiglie massacrate, fedeli rapiti: ma dov'è l'indignazione in Europa?

Guardate questa parte dell'Aula, quella a sinistra, è vuota. Non c'è un parlamentare di sinistra che oggi si scaglia contro il massacro dei cristiani. Volevo vedere se era stato ucciso un musulmano: erano tutti qua, era tutto pieno, era tutta piena l'Aula, a sinistra, a dire "islamofobia".
In quest'Aula si sente parlare soltanto di islamofobia. E di cristianofobia, qualcuno vuole cominciare a parlarne? Qualcuno vuole cominciare a difendere i cristiani nel mondo?
Ecco, l'Unione europea deve condizionare aiuti e cooperazione alla protezione delle comunità cristiane e pretendere dal governo nigeriano sicurezza e giustizia.

paragraphs.text: Κυρία Πρόεδρε, πριν δύο εβδομάδες, στις 22 Ιουνίου, εισέβαλαν στο χωριό Kawel της Νιγηρίας ένοπλοι και εκτέλεσαν τουλάχιστον 20 χριστιανούς αμάχους. Ανάμεσά τους ο πάστορας Markus Nyam και μια έγκυος γυναίκα. Δυστυχώς, αυτό δεν είναι μεμονωμένο περιστατικό· είναι μοτίβο. Σύμφωνα με το πρόγραμμα Open Doors, η Νιγηρία καταγράφει τους περισσότερους δολοφονημένους για την πίστη τους χριστιανούς από κάθε άλλη χώρα στον πλανήτη. Είναι θλιβερό. Επανερχόμαστε ξανά και ξανά θέτοντας το ζήτημα της προστασίας των χριστιανικών πληθυσμών, αλλά η ευρωπαϊκή και η παγκόσμια κοινότητα κάνει πως δεν ακούει. Μένουμε απλοί παρατηρητές στα εγκλήματα που συντελούνται από μουσουλμάνους μετανάστες εναντίον γηγενών Ευρωπαίων μέσα στο σπίτι μας, σε χώρες της Ευρώπης, και κλείνουμε τα μάτια μας. Περιμένουμε απλά την καταστροφική εξέλιξη αυτών των γεγονότων.

Πρέπει να ξυπνήσουμε άμεσα. Εδώ, στο Ευρωπαϊκό Κοινοβούλιο, πρέπει να θέσουμε την προστασία αυτών των κοινοτήτων ως άμεση προτεραιότητα, με κυρώσεις και πίεση προς την Νιγηρία αλλά και προς όλες τις χώρες όπου διώκονται και δολοφονούνται συστηματικά χριστιανοί. Η Ευρώπη οφείλει να δράσει τώρα. Πρέπει να προστατεύσει τους γηγενείς πληθυσμούς της από την ανεξέλεγκτη μετανάστευση και την εξάπλωση του ισλαμιστικού εξτρεμισμού.

paragraphs.text: Tisztelt Elnök Asszony! Ez most a harmadik alkalom, hogy ebben a ciklusban a nigériai keresztényüldözés kérdésével foglalkozunk. Sajnálatos, hogy dacára ennek, a Bizottság – és itt azért többen is – mindent elkövet, hogy a keresztényekkel szembeni támadásokat kizárólag etnikai konfliktusként próbálja beállítani. A keresztényüldözés tényének elismerésétől a von der Leyen–bizottság úgy tart, mint ördög a szenteltvíztől. Holott óvatos becslések szerint 2024 óta – hölgyeim és uraim, tisztelt képviselőtársaim – tízezer keresztény ember veszítette életét pusztán a hite miatt Nigériában.

A karácsonyra, húsvétra, pünkösdre időzített, templomok elleni támadásokat nem lehet félremagyarázni. Hány halott kell még ahhoz, hogy a keresztényüldözést ne akarják relativizálni? Hány halott kell még, hogy végre megfelelő forrásokat tegyenek az üldözött keresztények védelméért és a közösségek támogatásáért? És kérdés: mit tesz a Bizottság, a külügyi szolgálat a keresztények elleni erőszak megelőzéséhez? Nagyon megtisztelő lenne, ha végre érdemi választ kapnánk.

paragraphs.text: Poštovana predsjedavajuća, kolegice i kolege, kršćani su najprogonjenija vjerska skupina na svijetu.

Mediji ignoriraju tu činjenicu, ova plenarna dvorana je prazna. Danas stojimo pred užasnim masakrom u selu Kawel u Nigeriji, gdje su militanti 22. lipnja upali u to selo i ubili desetke nedužnih ljudi, svećenike, žene i djecu. Dok osuđujemo ovaj masakr kršćanske vrijednosti, kršćanstvo kao temelj europske civilizacije je na udaru. Dok ne progovorimo o tome, dok ne prestanu antikršćanski napadi, vandalizmi, vandalizam na crkvama, gotovo svaki tjedan nova crkva je u plamenu, stvari neće se promijeniti.
Moramo jasno i glasno progovoriti u ime ne samo nedužnih ljudi u svijetu koji trpe, nego kršćana u samoj Europi koji postaju danas meta raznoraznih skupina i napada.

Nažalost, Europa je to izgubila iz vida. I dok se to ne promijeni, bojim se da ćemo ići dalje krivim smjerom.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, the massacre of Christians in Kawel village is not an isolated tragedy. It's a part of a long and brutal campaign of violence carried out by Islamist extremists and radicalised foreign militants against Christian communities in Nigeria. Families are murdered, churches are burned and entire villages are wiped out simply because these people confess the Christian faith.

Europe must stop pretending that it is merely a local conflict over land. Islamist terrorism is one of its driving forces, and political correctness must never prevent us from naming that reality. Those who kill in the name of religious extremism are terrorists, and they must be called exactly that. The European Union must demand accountability from the Nigerian authorities, support the victims and make the protection of religious freedom a real priority of its foreign policy.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, mes chers collègues, la persécution sanglante des chrétiens se propage en Afrique subsaharienne, et le Nigeria est particulièrement touché par ce drame. Ces populations sont tuées, violées, déplacées et traitées dans des conditions atroces. Les églises sont incendiées, et les enlèvements massifs dans les écoles chrétiennes se multiplient. Les 13 et 14 juin encore, plus de 250 personnes ont été tuées par les milices islamistes. Un autre exemple de leur barbarie: Leah Sharibu, une jeune femme de 21 ans, est détenue depuis 2018 par un groupe islamiste car elle refuse d’abjurer sa foi chrétienne.

Le Nigeria est également touché par une grave crise humanitaire: des milliers de familles sont contraintes de fuir les violences; elles vivent dans des conditions indignes, privées d’aide humanitaire et de soins.

Pour ces familles et pour toutes les victimes de cette violence, notre devoir est clair: cesser les pudeurs diplomatiques, désigner les responsables, éradiquer les coupables de ces crimes, cibler et conditionner nos financements, soutenir les communautés menacées, porter haut et fort la voix des chrétiens persécutés.

interventions.speaker_label: Dubravka Šuica, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, honourable Members, at the end of this debate, the European Union would like to express its solidarity with the victims of massacres and abductions committed in Nigeria, as well as with their families enduring grief and suffering. The European Union strongly condemns these cruel attacks targeting vulnerable populations across the country. Nigeria has been facing systematic and insecurity affecting Christians and Christian communities and places of worship.

It is important to bear in mind that violence in Nigeria cuts across ethno-religious boundaries, with victims coming from all faiths and backgrounds. The recent attack on Kawel village in Plateau State cost the lives of 21 people. Although the victims belong to a Christian community and the offenders were of Fulani Muslim origin, the underlying conflict does not only have a religious dimension. It is also closely related to extended fights between farmers and herders. It is intensified by shrinking agricultural land, difficult access to resources and political tensions.

During her recent visit to Nigeria on 23 March, HR/VP Kallas delivered the message of support to Nigerian authorities engaged in a difficult fight against Boko Haram and other extremist groups. She stressed the complexity of this phenomenon of violence with its deep-rooted socio-economic, political and historical dimensions. She pledged to continue stepping up EU-Nigeria cooperation against terrorism and violent extremism and strengthening the whole-of-society approach for the prevention of violence and conflict in Nigeria.

While keeping our strong commitment to religious freedom and non-discrimination, we must support Nigerian voices calling for sustainable peace and opposing the stigmatisation of specific communities. Over the last years, the European Union has taken action to address the dire situation in Nigeria. Together with its Member States, it has implemented many projects on prevention of violence, peacebuilding and support of populations affected by violence.

The European Union has acted to promote dialogue in Nigeria and kept regular dialogue with its religious leaders – leaders from all faiths. The European Union stands ready to work alongside Nigerian authorities and international partners to strengthen the protection of vulnerable communities in Nigeria, of course, including Christians.

Deja, vis dažniau pasirodo nerimą keliančių pranešimų apie krikščionių genocidą Nigerijoje ir Sudane.Nigerijos bažnyčia prašo pagalbos ir persekiojimo užbaigimo. Kaip Europos Parlamentas, atstovaujantis lotyniškajai civilizacijai, pagrįstai krikščioniškomis vertybėmis, negalime ignoruoti šio pagalbos šauksmo. Privalome pasitelkti visas įmanomas priemones, kad paveiktume Nigerijos valdžią ir kuo greičiau nutrauktume persekiojimą. Nigerijoje tikėjimas Kristumi kainuoja žmonių gyvybes. Deginami krikščionių kaimai, o vien per pastaruosius dvejus metus nužudytųjų skaičius viršijo 7000. Remiantis organizacijos „Open Doors“ duomenimis, per pastaruosius 16 metų Nigerijoje buvo nužudyta 125 000 krikščionių. Vietos bažnyčia perspėja, kad krikščionių padėtis, ypač centrinėje šalies dalyje, prilygsta genocidui. Didžiausi smurto židiniai yra šalies centrinėje dalyje, kur džihadistai žudo krikščionis. Dėl šios padėties kuriama daug pabėgėlių stovyklų, kuriose humanitarinė padėtis yra apgailėtina. Vien Maiduguri mieste yra daugiau nei 30 šalies viduje perkeltų asmenų stovyklų, kuriose gyvena šimtai tūkstančių perkeltųjų. Nigerijos krikščionių bendruomenė gali susidurti su egzistencine grėsme. Todėl būtina, kad tarptautinė bendruomenė nedelsdama imtųsi veiksmų ir padėtų persekiojamiesiems. Europos Sąjunga negali likti abejinga šiam klausimui.

paragraphs.text: Poštovana predsjedavajuća, povjerenice, kolegice i kolege, kršćani su najprogonjenija vjerska skupina na svijetu.

Zato Europska unija mora iskoristiti sve instrumente svoje vanjske i razvojne politike kako bi zaštitila položaj kršćana gdje god su izloženi progonu, nasilju i sustavnoj diskriminaciji. U tom kontekstu posebno zabrinjavaju učestali slučajevi prisilne islamizacije kršćana u Pakistanu. Ondje se maloljetne kršćanske djevojčice otimaju, prisilno obraćaju na islam i prisiljavaju na brak sa svojim otmičarima. To nije samo teško kršenje ljudskih prava, nego i oblik vjerskog progona kojemu ne smijemo više okretati leđa. Slučaj trinaestogodišnje, naglašavam trinaestogodišnje Marije Shahbaz koja je nakon otmice prisilno obraćena na islam i udana za svojeg otmičara tragično potvrđuje razmjere ovog progona. Procjenjuje se da se svake godine u Pakistanu otme oko tisuću djevojčica, od kojih su mnoge kršćanke, kako bi bile prisilno obraćene i udane. To mora prestati.

Kolegice i kolege, Europska unija mora ovo pitanje dosljedno postavljati u svim svojim političkim i gospodarskim odnosima s Pakistanom i jasno dati do znanja da progon kršćana neće ostati bez odgovora.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, in Pakistan sono 19 milioni le spose bambine a cui viene strappata l'infanzia e vengono negati l'istruzione e il futuro in nome di un patriarcato brutale, che considera la pubertà biologica come garanzia di maturità per il matrimonio.

Il dramma delle spose bambine, però, è solo la punta di un iceberg, di una violazione sistematica dei diritti. Alle donne sono vietati il lavoro e l'istruzione, ma anche votare e persino aprire un conto in banca, senza un uomo accanto: una vera e propria apartheid basata su una disuguaglianza di genere, ma anche su una discriminazione dovuta alla povertà e all'esclusione sociale, in particolare delle minoranze.

È più che mai urgente una legislazione che protegga le donne e le bambine, rispondendo alle denunce di matrimoni forzati, accertando le responsabilità e offrendo alle vittime un sostegno completo e inclusivo, compresi rifugi sicuri, assistenza legale e consulenza psicologica.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, de zaak van Maria Shahbaz staat niet op zichzelf: ieder jaar worden in Pakistan honderden christelijke meisjes en hindoemeisjes ontvoerd, gedwongen zich te bekeren tot de islam en te trouwen met een vaak veel oudere moslimman.

Dat is een mensonterende praktijk die niet alleen strijdig is met de vrijheid van godsdienst, maar ook een ernstige aantasting vormt van de rechten van het kind, de rechten van de ouders en het recht op vrijheid en veiligheid.

Vandaag doen wij met onze breedgedragen resolutie een dringend appel op de Pakistaanse autoriteiten om een einde te maken aan deze gedwongen huwelijken, en Maria Shahbaz de vrijheid te geven om terug te keren naar haar ouders.

Pakistan wil graag aanspraak blijven maken op het stelsel van algemene tariefpreferenties plus. Daar valt over te praten, maar dan verwachten we wel het volledig respecteren van de rechten van minderheden.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, chers collègues, notre résolution s’adresse aux autorités du Pakistan. L’enlèvement, la conversion religieuse forcée, le mariage forcé de Maria Shahbaz, 13 ans, et à travers elle de toutes les autres jeunes filles soumises au même régime, sont contraires à la convention des droits de l’enfant et à la convention internationale sur l’élimination de toutes les formes de discrimination à l’égard des femmes – conventions que le Pakistan a pourtant ratifiées il y a déjà trente ans. Ne pas les appliquer l’expose à un retrait de son accès privilégié au marché européen.

Je m’adresse aussi à l’Union européenne: nous avons la capacité d’améliorer la situation des droits de l’homme, des femmes, des minorités, des enfants, en tant que deuxième partenaire commercial du Pakistan.

Nous attendons le respect de l’état de droit et l’interdiction des mariages forcés et des mariages d’enfants, la mise en place de mécanismes de soutien aux victimes, et que l‘on s’attaque aussi aux racines de ces problèmes que sont les inégalités et discriminations fondées sur le genre, la religion, la caste, mais aussi la pauvreté et l’exclusion sociale.

paragraphs.text: Κυρία Πρόεδρε, όλοι είμαστε δίπλα σε κάθε κορίτσι που το υποχρεώνουν να παντρευτεί έναν ενήλικο ή υπέργηρο άντρα ενώ είναι ακόμα παιδί. Ειδικά όταν πρόκειται για ένα νεαρό χριστιανόπουλο που με το ζόρι το αλλαξοπιστούν. Δεν χρειάζεται όμως να πάμε στο Πακιστάν ή στο Αφγανιστάν για να το δούμε, γιατί το βλέπουμε στην Ευρώπη. Χάρη στις αριστερές και κεντροαριστερές πολιτικές σας φέρατε τη σαρία, την μπούρκα, τις κλειτοριδεκτομές και τους γάμους ανηλίκων εδώ, στην Ευρώπη. Οι φανατικοί ισλαμιστές δεν ενσωματώνονται, δεν αποδέχονται τις δυτικές αξίες και αποτελούν τεράστιο κίνδυνο για τις κοινωνίες μας. Δείτε τι συμβαίνει λίγο με τους βιασμούς, τις δολοφονίες, τις ληστείες και την εγκληματικότητα, που τα μέσα μαζικής ενημέρωσης φυσικά κρύβουν σε πολλές ευρωπαϊκές χώρες. Δείτε τι έχει γίνει στην Αγγλία.

Λυπάμαι πολύ για όσα συμβαίνουν στο Πακιστάν, αλλά περισσότερο λυπάμαι που τα βλέπουμε όλο και συχνότερα στην πατρίδα μου, την Ελλάδα, και στην Ευρώπη. Θέλετε λύση; Κόψτε κάθε οικονομική συναλλαγή με το Πακιστάν και απελάστε τους Πακιστανούς που βρίσκονται στην Ευρώπη παράνομα. Θα δείτε τότε πόσο γρήγορα θα υποχωρήσουν —αλλά δεν θέλετε λύσεις. Θέλετε μόνο να κάνετε πως ενδιαφέρεστε. Λυπάμαι, αλλά σε αυτό το στημένο παιχνίδι δεν θα συμμετέχω. Islam out of Europe!

paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin, Frau Kommissarin! Was für ein Martyrium! Maria Shahbaz, 13 Jahre jung, Christin. Sie wurde entführt, sie musste zum Islam zwangskonvertieren, sie wurde gezwungen, ihren eigenen Entführer zu heiraten – einen 30 Jahre alten Moslem. Schlimm und in Pakistan keine Seltenheit; nur, bei uns in Europa leider auch nicht. Es ist sogar noch schlimmer, denn das, was Maria Shahbaz widerfahren ist, kommt mir irgendwie bekannt vor.

250 000 weiße minderjährige Mädchen wurden jahrzehntelang sexuell ausgebeutet von Grooming-Gangs in Großbritannien. Fast alle Täter waren muslimische Männer, überwiegend pakistanischer Herkunft. Die Mädchen wurden von ihren Verbrechern systematisch angesprochen, manipuliert, mit Drogen betäubt, geschlagen, gewürgt, gefoltert, mit Zigaretten verbrannt und immer wieder vergewaltigt. Viele dieser Mädchen wurden schwanger, viele erlitten Fehlgeburten, viele mussten abtreiben. Ihre Peiniger nannten sie weiße Schlampen, weiße Huren, weiße Fotzen, weißen Abschaum und Kuffar‑Schlampen. Während sie vergewaltigt wurden, verspottete man sie wegen ihres christlichen Glaubens: Ihr Gott habe sie verlassen, ihr christlicher Glaube biete keinen Schutz.

Zu den Opfern gehörte Chloe, gerade einmal zwölf Jahre alt. Ihr wurde Whiskey eingeschenkt, bevor sie vergewaltigt wurde. Als der Täter von ihr ließ, stieß er ihr eine leere Whiskeyflasche in die Vagina, wo sie zerbrach. Kate wiederum wurde von einem Hund vergewaltigt, während pakistanische Männer Wetten abschlossen, ob der Hund in ihre Vagina oder ihren Anus eindringen würde. Alles wurde gefilmt; Kate wurde gezwungen, die Aufnahme immer wieder anzuschauen.

Dieser importierte Horror – das sind keine Einzelfälle, das ist hunderttausendfach passiert; Maria Shahbaz ist überall. Polizei, Politik, Medien, MeToo‑Feministinnen – sie alle hielten die Klappe. Warum? Um dem Rassismusvorwurf zu entgehen. Sogenannter Antirassismus ist im Ergebnis feiger Rassismus gegen Weiße, suizidale Empathie zugunsten fremder Vergewaltiger und zulasten weißer Mädchen.

Dreimal habe ich eine Debatte hierzu gefordert, dreimal wurde das abgelehnt; stattdessen sprachen wir über Nicaragua, Burkina Faso und Weißrussland. Derweil erscheinen immer häufiger Presseberichte über Grooming-Gangs in Deutschland. Ich verspreche Ihnen, ich werde dagegen ankämpfen …

paragraphs.text: Gospa predsednica, kolegice in kolegi! Ko se vživim v zgodbo Marie Šahbaz, me oblije groza, ker imam sam doma 13 letno hčerko. In ko si zamislim, da bi jo nekdo ugrabil, jo prisilil, da spremeni svojo vero, jo prisilil, da se poroči, in ko bi to prijavil policiji, policija ne bi nič odreagirala. paragraphs.text: Señora presidenta, el caso de Maria Shahbaz es la historia de un secuestro, de una conversión forzosa, de un matrimonio infantil que simboliza la grave situación que siguen sufriendo muchas niñas en demasiados países del mundo. Ninguna persona —y mucho menos una niña— debe verse privada de su libertad, de su infancia, de su vida.

No podemos quedarnos callados, pero tampoco actuar con un doble rasero. Por eso, al mismo tiempo que condenamos este caso, creo que debemos protestar también por la visita reciente de una delegación de talibanes a Bruselas y sus contactos con la Comisión Europea.

Nunca, nunca jamás, podemos legitimar un régimen como el talibán que continúa negando a las mujeres y a las niñas afganas derechos fundamentales, su dignidad como seres humanos. La Unión Europea no puede ser hipócrita, debe ser coherente con los valores que defiende y exigir justicia para las víctimas, proteger a las niñas frente a la violencia y mantener una defensa firme e inequívoca de los derechos humanos, ya sea en Pakistán, en Afganistán o en cualquier lugar en el que sean vulnerados. Por favor, actuemos con decencia.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, Maria Shahbaz, una ragazza cristiana di 13 anni, viene rapita in Pakistan, costretta a convertirsi all'Islam e infine obbligata a sposare il suo rapitore.
E, nonostante la denuncia dei genitori per il rapimento, il giudice che cosa ha fatto? Ha rimandato la ragazzina a vivere proprio con l'uomo che l'aveva rapita.

Un orrore in un paese dove ogni anno circa 1 000 ragazze – molte delle quali cristiane – vengono rapite dalle loro case, convertite con la forza all'Islam e date in sposa contro la loro volontà. In Pakistan, secondo l'Unicef, ci sono stati 19 milioni di spose bambine, bambine e donne sottomesse e oppresse da una violenza inaudita. Il tutto in nome di Allah.

E cosa fa l'Europa per contrastare queste pratiche disumane e per difendere milioni di donne che subiscono questi abusi? Cosa fa per tutelare le minoranze cristiane che ogni giorno subiscono indegne persecuzioni?
Volete finalmente concentrarvi sulla terribile visione della donna e delle bambine in molti paesi islamici, e purtroppo anche in certe comunità in Europa, o continuiamo a far finta di nulla?

Inget barn gifter sig av fri vilja med en vuxen man. Det här är barbariskt och hör inte hemma i en civiliserad värld. Inget barn ska behöva bli bortfört, tvingas byta religion eller pressas in i ett äktenskap. Ändå har EU alltför länge blundat för det här.

Por tanto, se hace necesaria una potentísima respuesta diplomática de primer grado para evitar que se ignore ningún caso así ni se pueda mirar para otro lado.

paragraphs.text: Señora presidente, desgraciadamente el caso de Maria no es un caso aislado. Pakistán no es el único país del mundo donde a la mujer no se le reconoce su dignidad, se la obliga a casarse de niña o es agredida. Todavía más si no son musulmanas, entonces se las obliga a renunciar a su fe y se las viola de forma brutal.

No, no es el único país del mundo, también ha ocurrido en Europa: casos de explotación infantil insuficientemente denunciados en esta Cámara, redes donde choca el contraste entre víctimas y agresores —niñas blancas, cristianas—. Porque quien tiene esta perversa mentalidad la mantiene aunque viaje y se instale entre nosotros.

Lo que nos escandaliza fuera de Europa no deberíamos quererlo para los nuestros. ¿Quién está entrando en España con la regularización masiva? Está claro que el que tiene malas intenciones se aprovecha de estas oportunidades.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, the case of Maria Shahbaz is a warning for all of us about Islamisation. At just 13 years old, this Christian girl was abducted by a 30‑year‑old Muslim man, forcibly converted to Islam and married against her will. The Pakistani court denied Maria justice. It upheld the marriage, neglecting evidence of abduction, her underage status and her parents' desperate pleas.

Hundreds and hundreds of girls, mostly from religious minorities, have suffered the same fate in Pakistan. Europe must learn from this. Mass migration from Islamic nations where sharia prevails imports these risks. If we want to prevent future European girls from facing Maria's fate, we have work to do. We must prevent the Islamisation of Europe.

paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin, liebe Menschen Europas! Was Maria Shahbaz passiert ist, ist unfassbares Unrecht. Und für mich ist das eigenständige Unrecht dann, was danach passiert ist, dass die Gerichte in Pakistan versagt haben, dass diesem Unrecht, das diesem jungen Mädchen passiert ist, keine Gerechtigkeit widerfahren ist.

Wir leben in einer Welt, in der es kein System internationaler Gerechtigkeit gibt, in der die UN, in der internationale Gerichte, in der solche Behörden wie Interpol keine Möglichkeit haben, Unrecht zu bekämpfen, wenn es in einem souveränen Staat dieser Erde passiert. Und solange wir das nicht lösen, solange wir uns als Europäische Union nicht für eine ernsthafte Reform des internationalen Rechts und der internationalen Organisationen einsetzen, wird es immer wieder solche Fälle wie den von Maria Shahbaz geben – und das auf der ganzen Welt.
Das ist das, was wir ändern müssen, und das ist das, was wir als EU, Frau Kommissarin, auch ändern können.

interventions.speaker_label: Dubravka Šuica, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, honourable Members, the case of Maria Shahbaz is deeply troubling. Maria was reportedly 13 when she was taken from her family in Lahore, converted to Islam and married to an adult man. Her father went to court arguing that she was a minor and could not lawfully consent. Yet the proceedings did not deliver the clear child-protection response that such a case demands, including under international law.

We know this is not an isolated case in Pakistan. It reflects a wider pattern of abduction, forced conversion and forced marriage of girls coming from minorities. There are other key issues that challenge equal citizenship and equal protection under the law – the misuse of blasphemy allegations, the persecution of Ahmadis, the caste-based discrimination affecting Dalits and Scheduled Castes, many of them Hindu or Christian.

The European Union has not been silent. We have raised these concerns repeatedly and directly with Pakistan, including during our strategic dialogues and our joint commissions. We are perfectly aware that these issues are sensitive for our Pakistani counterparts, but they cannot be postponed, minimised or treated as side matters in our relationship.

Pakistan must do more to protect minors, ensure prompt police registration, apply child protection standards consistently and prosecute those who exploit religious or cultural grounds to deprive others of rights which are clearly enshrined in international law.

We recognise Pakistan has taken some steps, including on child marriage and child protection policy frameworks. This is undoubtedly positive, but protection is measured by outcomes: safe return of the person, investigation of forged documents, punishment of perpetrators. Only then can vulnerable individuals and communities fully trust their state, whether in Pakistan or in any country.

Pakistan is an important partner for the European Union, and precisely for that reason our dialogue must remain candid. Pakistan is the largest beneficiary of the Generalised Scheme of Preferences Plus worldwide. Preferential access to the European market is linked to implementation of international conventions, including on human rights. The continuation and renewal of GSP+ is linked to real, measurable and sustained progress in respecting the international commitments upon which it is based. Under these international commitments, equal citizenship, freedom of religion or belief and protection of minority women and girls are not optional, but obligatory.

political_group.label: PPE
political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

interventions.speaker_label: Thomas Byrne, President-in-Office of the Council.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, honourable and distinguished Members, Commissioner Šuica, in today's world, we are faced with cyberattacks that wish to expose vulnerabilities in our cybersecurity. Such attacks need our full attention because cybersecurity is essential to protect economic activity and critical infrastructure in our Union. Cybersecurity is also about protecting our electronic devices, such as smartphones, where we keep much of our private and professional data.

Attempts to undermine the security of our private data undermine the right to privacy and data protection and freedom of expression. But let's be clear: the ultimate target of such attacks are our democracies and the rule of law. The use of commercial spyware to monitor the press, politicians and public institutions represents a massive challenge to democratic accountability. And while Member States and the European Union are constantly stepping up their efforts to increase cybersecurity, so do those who want to harm our values and our Union. That is why we need to focus on strengthening our democratic resilience.

L’une des facettes de la résilience démocratique est la protection de nos démocraties contre les attaques, notamment les menaces hybrides, la manipulation de l’information et les ingérences étrangères, ainsi que la désinformation.

L’autre facette de la résilience démocratique réside dans la protection de la liberté de nos citoyens et de nos médias, de la tenue d’élections libres et équitables et ainsi que de la solidité des institutions et des processus démocratiques.

Je tiens à vous assurer que le renforcement de la résilience démocratique constitue une priorité majeure pour nos États membres, non seulement à l’échelon national, mais aussi à travers le partage d’informations, la coopération opérationnelle et le renforcement conjoint des capacités.
Ce renforcement de la résilience démocratique est également l’objectif du bouclier européen de la démocratie, que nous sommes actuellement en train de mettre en œuvre.

As Irish Presidency, we are committed to supporting all these efforts in strengthening democratic resilience. During the next semester, we will be paying attention to the protection of citizens online, notably our children, and the safety of political candidates and elected representatives.

I know that these are important issues for the European Parliament as well and I am sure that we will have the occasion to exchange on such matters with you in the months to come. Thank you very much for your attention.
